subject: [PATCH 33/60] cgroup/cpuset: ignore private nodes when matching OOM victims

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Identified a potential issue with private nodes being considered in OOM killer decisions. Proposed a change to exclude private nodes from the intersection check, which would prevent unnecessary task killings.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues in the cgroup/cpuset subsystem, specifically focusing on memory management and OOM killer interactions. The goal is to improve the accuracy of OOM victim selection by considering private nodes when determining memory intersections.
